Question: Can students from the Management degree transition to the  Data Science program ?
Answer: Yes , students from Management program transition to Data science program under conditions which will be announced shortly

Question: Can I switch from Management degree to other BS program (Electronics System/Aeronautics and Space Technology) ?
Answer:
No Transition from Management and Data Science Degree to Electronics System/Aeronautics and Space Technology is not allowed. If you are interested you have to enroll as qualifier student in respective program you're interested to apply.

Please note student cannot pursue more than one BS program at the same time.

Question: Can I change program DS to MG and vice versa after MAY 2026 term qualifier?
Answer: Yes, If you have cleared the May 2026 term qualifier and wishes to enroll to the foundation level in the same term then yes, you can change the program from DS to MG and vice versa.
